goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.bridge: You stand on a crumbling bridge. Behind you are those who have not yet crossed; from the far side, beasts are closing in. Where will you stand?
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.bridge.a1: In the middle of the bridge, holding firm, so the beasts must face me first.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.bridge.a2: On a high rock at the end of the bridge, bringing them down one by one before they draw near.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.bridge.a3: Beside those left behind, holding their hands until every last one has crossed.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.campfire: It is night on a long journey, and your companions sleep beside the fire. You alone are awake. What are you doing?
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.campfire.a1: Watching the forest beyond, weighing what must fall first when morning comes.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.campfire.a2: Whispering to the small lights drifting by the fire, asking them to guard the sleepers' dreams.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.campfire.a3: Keeping a blade across my knees and my eyes on the dark, ready to rise before anyone else.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.gift: If I were to grant you a single power, what shape would you wish it to take?
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.gift.a1: A power that raises the fallen, so that no one at my side ever falls alone.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.gift.a2: A body and arms strong enough to plunge into the heart of the enemy and never break.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage1.gift.a3: A power that reaches beyond sight, so I can end the danger before it comes close.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage2.vanguard.beast: A colossal beast bars your way. What do you hold in your hands?
A sword in one hand and a shield in the other. I will take its blows, and strike when it opens.
A shield large enough to cover my whole body. Nothing gets past it.
A blade so heavy I need both hands to lift it. One clean hit is all it takes.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage2.vanguard.ally: The battle drags on, and one of your companions is in danger. What will you do?
Taunt the enemy and draw its eyes to me. If anyone is to be hurt, let it be me alone.
Calmly move to their side, turn aside the enemy's blows, and look for the moment to strike back.
Charge straight at whatever is after them and keep pressing until it falls.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage2.vanguard.scars: After the battle, you look over the marks left on your body and your arms. What do you hope to see?
A body covered in wounds. Even so, I was the one still standing at the end.
A slightly dulled edge and a scratched shield. Proof that both did their part.
A shield dented all over. It means I held back that much.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage3.vanguard.child: Think back to when you were small. What was the first thing your body came to know?
The feel of swinging a stick like a sword. Whatever I held fit my hand.
A body that got right back up after every fall and bump. Pain never bent me easily.
I was always slower than the others. But once I learned something, I never forgot it.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage3.vanguard.first: On the day you were first caught up in a real fight, how did your body move?
I forgot all about defending and my hands moved first. When I came to, the other one was down.
I curled up and held on to the end. I never swung a blade, but I never fell, either.
My body moved on its own. Strangely… I have never fought that well since.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage3.vanguard.learn: When do you learn most deeply?
When I repeat the same motion a thousand, ten thousand times, until my hands remember it on their own.
When I take hit after hit, until my body learns where to catch a blow so it hurts less.
In real battle, with my life at stake. One true fight teaches more than a hundred drills.
goddessrpg.inquiry.stage3.vanguard.journ: At the end of a long road, you will meet yourself. Who do you hope to find there?
Someone who draws their blade without hesitation before any foe. I will leave the guarding to others.
My edge can be dull. I want to be someone who never loses anyone standing behind me.
Someone not so different from who I am now. There is no need to hurry; that is enough.
goddessrpg.goddess.name: The Goddess
goddessrpg.inquiry.greeting: Welcome, traveler of long roads. I am the goddess who lights the paths of this land. I would like to ask you a few things about who you are. There are no right answers, so answer as your heart leads.
goddessrpg.inquiry.outro: [Goddess] Thank you. I have heard your heart. Your path is written in this tome; open it whenever you wish. May you walk in peace.
